pagerduty-bot: [P1] inference-pool-usw: multiple nodes NotReady + kubelet restarts, customer-facing latency spike detected. PagerDuty trigger: 3/5 nodes flapping in 10m window.

ana (oncall): taking this, will triage. tagging @maria, @sam, @kai.

maria (runtime): saw a surge of GPU OOMs and container restarts in the logs right before the kubelet went NotReady. stack traces reference `libcuda` errors and repeated container restarts with oom_killer entries. attaching quick grep results. :eyes:

maria (runtime): ```
2026-02-28T12:03:14Z runtime[rt0]: ERROR container: exit code 137 (OOM) - model=redwood-xxl, pod=infer-abc-123
2026-02-28T12:03:19Z runtime[rt0]: ERROR cuda: cuCtxDestroy failed: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION
2026-02-28T12:03:20Z kubelet[...]: NodeStatus NotReady - Kubelet restarted
```

sam (infra): confirming nodes `usw-ig-03..05` showing kubelet restart loops. kernel logs show `NMI: watchdog` before reboot on one host. Could be hardware/driver flakiness after a nightly driver rollout we did earlier.

kai (sre): customer impact? are any requests 5xxing or timing out?

ana (oncall): yes, multiple customers on dedicated capacity reported increased 5xx and token latency > 3s for text-generation routes. Routing fallback fired to secondary pool but there was a backlog. Sending customer comms flag to customer-success.

maria (runtime): quick mitigation: remove problematic nodes from service and scale up warm spare nodes in another AZ to keep latency SLO. I'll open a hotfix to ensure routing bypasses the flapping pool.

sam (infra): doing cordon/drain on the flapping nodes now to stop scheduling new pods.

sam (infra): ```
kubectl cordon node/usw-ig-03
kubectl drain node/usw-ig-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```

sam (infra): cordoned 03/04/05. draining; pods moving to other nodes but some gpu-pinned pods can't reschedule due to taints/affinity.

maria (runtime): for those GPU-pinned pods, I'm adding a temporary taint-toleration override on the warm pool to accept them. also enabling model-variant fallback (cpu-quantized) for low-priority requests to reduce GPU pressure.

kai (sre): are we recreating nodes or rebooting them? We need to decide whether to patch driver or revert driver rollout.

sam (infra): rolling back the driver rollout to previous AMI tag is safest if driver is suspect. I'm spinning up replacement nodes running the previous driver in us-west-2b.

maria (runtime): temporary routing change applied: traffic->inference-usw now prefers `inference-usw-warm` pool, with canary fallback back to healthy nodes only. watching queue lengths.

deploy-bot: Route update applied to `inference-routing` (change-id: r-20260228-01). TTL=30s.

ana (oncall): @kai can you monitor customer-facing error rates and confirm when the spike subsides? I'll keep the pager active.

kai (sre): watching Grafana panels. Error rate peaked at +2.1% for generation API, now down to +0.4% after routing shift. Latency p95 reduced from 4.8s to 1.7s. :thumbsup:

maria (runtime): logs show fewer OOMs after migrating traffic and draining nodes. However, kubelet restarts continued on two drained nodes - likely unrelated hardware watchdog. I'll mark those nodes for reimage.

sam (infra): reimage planned: creating reimage job and quarantining nodes from rotation until reimage completes. Reimage ticket: INF-3912.

ana (oncall): customer-impact summary for now: partial degradation for ~18 minutes, automated routing fallback mitigated most user-facing errors. No data loss. CS notified for affected dedicated customers.

maria (runtime): short-term actions: 1) keep warm pool elevated until reimage done 2) keep fallback enabled for low-priority traffic 3) post-incident eval on driver rollout gating.

kai (sre): long-term: add early-warning alert for correlated GPU OOM + kubelet restart pattern, and add gating to driver rollout orchestration (canary nodes + health-check windows).

ana (oncall): assigning follow-ups: @sam INF-3912 (reimage + HW diag), @maria RND-1582 (evaluate runtime's handling of libcuda errors), @kai RND-1583 (alerting + rollout gating). I'll create the postmortem doc after the incident closes.

sam (infra): reimage jobs queued. ETA 45m for full reimage of 3 nodes.

maria (runtime): monitoring for regression for next 2 hours, will escalate if any reoccurrence.

ana (oncall): marking incident as under control. leaving pager open for 2h watch. Great work team. :heart:
